description: 120 x 60 x 40 mm pillow-block bracket; y up. Grey cast iron E=110000 N/mm^2, nu=0.26. Two clamped 16 mm diameter washer footprints on y=0 at (x,z)=(15,20) and (105,20). Required solid seat: z-axis cylinder at (x,y)=(60,40), diameter 30 mm, z=0..40. Total shaft force (0,-3000,0) N shared over seat nodes. Volume fraction 0.3 applies to non-passive design volume, as clarified. Element edge 1 mm. Bolts represented by effective washer support patches.
